resources.string: Skyward profile import — brings your firearms and ammo over from another calculator app

Lets Skyward Ballistics bring your existing firearm, ammo and bullet profiles over from a supported calculator app. It only runs after you press Start under \"Import from another calculator app\", only reads, and never changes, saves or deletes anything in the other app. It makes no network connections.
Turn on \"Skyward profile import\" in Accessibility settings so Skyward can bring your profiles over.
Android 13+: if the switch is greyed out (\"Restricted setting\"), open App info → ⋮ menu → \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
